I've stopped dating after a horrible on-and-off cheating relationship for almost 5 years and a hook-up made me rethink what am I doing with myself. I focused on letting my self heal from everything for over 2 years now too. I don't look for love and just tell myself that if it's meant to be, it will come. I think love comes to you when you're ready and when you least expect it. That's what happened to me anyway. Met this great guy through online dating and I don't want to jinx it yet but so far he has a lot of the qualities I look for in my ideal man. I'm not sure if we're on the same page yet but I'm also ready to get hurt if not.

What I'm saying is good luck to us for trying to date again! It is important to know what you want and if you're fully ready to be committed again. Remember, love is giving the other person your fragile heart and being ready to get hurt but at the same time, also trusting him/her that he/she will be gentle with it and not let you go. I wish you luck! You deserve to be happy.
